trigger: First local Phase 0E receipt showed zero in-window headers because the corpus stores daily metrics as ZIP archives with .zip.CHECKSUM sidecars, while V0.1 only recognized .csv and .csv.gz containers.

allowed_container_amendment.zip_rule: For an eligible in-window archive, require exactly one non-directory CSV member and read only that member's first physical line as the header. Do not parse any data row.
allowed_container_amendment.checksum_sidecars: .zip.CHECKSUM files are provenance metadata; inventory/count them but do not classify them as candidate signal files and do not open their contents in Phase 0E.

fail_closed_conditions_added: eligible ZIP contains zero CSV members
eligible ZIP contains more than one CSV member
eligible ZIP cannot expose a decodable non-empty first line
eligible ZIP is corrupt or unreadable
